title: IP camera over HTTP
description: A camera's MJPEG stream, or its snapshot picture asked for a few times a second. For an RTSP camera, add its rtsp:// address as a stream, or let discovery find it.

uri.title: Camera address
uri.description: The camera's MJPEG or snapshot address, from its manual or its web page.

mode.title: What the address gives
mode.description: auto decides from the address: a .jpg or snapshot name is a still picture, anything else a stream.
x-gmx-labels: Work it out from the address

fps.title: Snapshots a second
fps.description: Only for a snapshot address. Most cameras answer 5 a second comfortably; more makes the camera and the network work harder.

user.title: User name
user.description: The camera's login, when it asks for one.
